Food Delivery (Swiggy, Zomato, FoodKart)

Flipkart's "FoodKart" machine-coding round, and the Zomato/Salesforce whiteboard version of it: restaurants with menus and a kitchen capacity, orders placed by a pluggable selection strategy, an order state machine, riders assigned from a queue. You will build the whole thing in Java, Python and C++, make it race-free, and learn the 90-minute plan that gets every feature demoable before time runs out.
